in_sanskrit.name: सुबासीष
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is the excellent master or lord of prosperity.

in_hindi.name: सुबासिश
in_hindi.meaning: सुबहुंत (subahunta) - Good, Excellent ईश्वर (ishvara) - God, Master, Lord
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who is a good and excellent God or Master.

in_tamil.name: Subasish
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Learned, Intelligent, Brave
in_tamil.long_meaning: Subasish ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। Suba means learned, intelligent. Sish means brave, heroic.

in_telugu.name: Subasish
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే Learned, Intelligent, Brave
in_telugu.long_meaning: Subasish ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Suba means learned, intelligent. Sish means brave, heroic.

in_marathi.name: Subasish
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Learned, Intelligent, Brave
in_marathi.long_meaning: Subasish हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Suba means learned, intelligent. Sish means brave, heroic.

in_bengali.name: Subasish
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Learned, Intelligent, Brave
in_bengali.long_meaning: Subasish একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Suba means learned, intelligent. Sish means brave, heroic.
